prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 临床试验 · 分组与随访 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "试验组（低剂量）" spans 1 col × 3 row; "对照组" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "分组" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 107px
  col 2: header "访视" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 67px
  col 3: header "时间窗" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 49px
  col 4: header "检查项目" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 346px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 480px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 479px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"呈现临床试验各组的访视时间和检查项目，便于核对随访安排。","reading":"先按分组读取，再沿行查看访视、时间窗和检查项目；跨行的组名帮助读者比较组内各次访视，也可对照两组的基线和随访安排。","groups":["“分组”和“访视”共同定位每条随访记录；组名跨行时，访视标识各条记录。","“访视”和“时间窗”共同说明何时检查，应方便横向对应。","“检查项目”是各次访视的主要内容，可在同一列内比较。"],"keep_intact":["表头","D0、D28 ± 3、D84 ± 7 等时间窗数值及其符号","基线、随访等短访视名称"],"may_wrap":["较长的组名可在自然词组边界换行，跨行单元格已有的高度可容纳换行。","第一次随访、第二次随访等较长访视名称可在必要时换行。","检查项目可在项目或标点之间换行；多项目记录适合利用自身行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [128, 88, 70, 193] · table 480×240px · row heights [33, 33, 73, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [85, 88, 70, 236] · table 480×220px · row heights [33, 33, 53, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [119, 88, 70, 202] · table 480×220px · row heights [33, 33, 53, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"组名、访视名称和时间窗均保持完整，分组与各次访视的对应关系清楚。","problems":"最长的检查项目占三行，使第一次随访行明显高于其余各行，检查内容也显得拥挤。","cause":"分组列宽128px足以容纳完整组名，但留给检查项目的193px不足以让最长内容排成两行。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"检查项目有充足空间，最长记录排成两行，行高和阅读节奏较紧凑；访视和时间窗也保持完整。","problems":"试验组名称被拆成三行，括号和剂量信息与组名分离，削弱了跨行组标签的辨识度。","cause":"分组列仅85px，可用文字宽度为64px；检查项目列236px则占用了较多宽度。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"最长检查记录排成两行，组内各次访视和时间窗容易横向对应；相比r2B，组名更集中。","problems":"试验组名称在“低剂量”内部断开，末尾“量）”单独落到下一行，视觉上不完整。","cause":"分组列119px的可用文字宽度为98px，略小于组名所需的107px；检查项目列202px则刚好支持较紧凑的两行排版。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"完整组名优先","widths":[128,85,67,199],"change":"将分组列恢复到足以容纳完整组名的128px，从访视和时间窗各借3px，给检查项目199px；检验能否同时保持时间窗完整及最长检查记录两行。"},{"name":"组名临界宽度","widths":[124,88,70,197],"change":"在r2C基础上给分组列增加5px，检查项目列相应减少5px；检验组名能否在更自然的位置换行，同时保留检查项目的两行节奏。"},{"name":"检查内容优先","widths":[115,88,70,206],"change":"从分组列转移4px到检查项目列，探索组名以自然词组换行、检查内容更从容的方案；重点检查括号及“低剂量”是否保持成组。"}]}
